pages.text: Part of the Arcane armour for Metal Golems: violet cloth and gold, in the manner of the Battlemage outfit. Each piece worn gives the golem one level of Source Mantle: 4% less magic damage and 1 health regained every 5 seconds, so the full set gives 16% and about 0.8 health per second. Armour 8, toughness 6 (diamond tier). Crafted at an Enchanting Apparatus from the matching diamond armour piece.
